dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Ace is on the at-risk list due to medical concerns. Ace is a friendly cat who was surrendered due owner unable to address their medical condition. We have assessed that Ace has heart disease and will require follow up evaluation with a cardiologist. Ace also has severe dental disease and would benefit from dentistry so long as he is a suitable anesthetic candidate. Ace has a history of urinating outside of the litterbox in his previously home but has seen some improvement with his litterbox use in the Care Center. Ace has allowed all handling and seeks attention during their exams.
dog.name: Ace
